Package neqsim.process.util.mercury

Class MercuryUnitResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.mercury.MercuryUnitResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MercuryUnitResult extends Object implements Serializable
Mercury balance of one unit operation: mercury entering, leaving and staying in the unit.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

  • Constructor Details

    • MercuryUnitResult

      MercuryUnitResult(String name, String type, double mercuryMolarMass, double[] flows, String freeMercuryState)
      Create the mercury balance of a unit operation.
      Parameters:
      name - name of the unit operation
      type - class name of the unit operation
      mercuryMolarMass - molar mass of mercury in kg/mol
      flows - mercury entering, leaving and held back as free mercury, in mole/sec
      freeMercuryState - state of the free mercury held back: none, liquid or solid

  • Method Details

    • getName

      public String getName()
      Get the name of the unit operation.
      Returns:
      unit operation name

    • getType

      public String getType()
      Get the type of the unit operation.
      Returns:
      simple class name, for example "Separator"

    • getInletMercuryFlowRate

      public double getInletMercuryFlowRate(String unit)
      Get the mercury entering the unit with its inlet streams.
      Parameters:
      unit - "mole/sec", "mole/hr", "kg/sec", "kg/min", "kg/hr", "kg/day", "kg/yr", "g/sec", "g/hr", "g/day" or "g/yr"
      Returns:
      flow of mercury
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getOutletMercuryFlowRate

      public double getOutletMercuryFlowRate(String unit)
      Get the mercury leaving the unit with its outlet streams.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getInletMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      flow of mercury
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getRetainedMercuryFlowRate

      public double getRetainedMercuryFlowRate(String unit)
      Get the mercury that stays in the unit.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getInletMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      mercury entering minus mercury leaving: free mercury held back in a separator, mercury taken up by a removal bed, or the remaining difference over a recycle that is not converged
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getFreeMercuryAccumulationRate

      public double getFreeMercuryAccumulationRate(String unit)
      Get the free mercury held back in a separator.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getInletMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      accumulation rate of free mercury, zero for other units and for separators without free mercury accumulation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getFreeMercuryState

      public String getFreeMercuryState()
      Get the state of the free mercury held back in a separator.
      Returns:
      "none", "liquid" or "solid"

      Map<String,Object> toMap()
      Get the result as a map for reporting.
